messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we're seeing a sharp drop in spot capacity signal in the asia-southeast1 GPU pool. Interruption rate spiked above our alert threshold in the last 10m. Anyone oncall?

ops-bot: Alert: spot_availability_drop | pool=asia-southeast1-gpu | interruption_rate=0.87 | triggered_at=2024-07-14T03:21:00Z :warning:

Juan: I'm on it. Quick question: is this likely market churn (cloud provider) or something in our autoscaler/placement logic? :thinking:

Liam: Saw increased host-level network errors in the telemetry for asia-southeast1-a around the same time. Could be noisy neighbors. Link: https://grafana.company/redwood/d/spot-health?var-zone=asia-southeast1-a

Juan: Ran a quick check:
```
sum by(zone) (rate(preemptions_total{pool="asia-southeast1-gpu"}[5m]))
/ sum by(zone) (machine_count{pool="asia-southeast1-gpu"})
```
Result: ~0.95 for asia-southeast1-a, ~0.12 for asia-southeast1-b. Pretty localized.

Sara: If it's localized to -a we should failover traffic away from that zone. We have ~8 spare GPUs in dedicated-asia-1 that can take load for a short period.

Kevin: Prefer automated fallback instead of manual DNS/flipping. Proposal:
```
routing:
  - name: asia-spot-fallback
    when:
      interruption_rate > 0.5
      slo_latency_pct_increase > 0.03
    action:
      route_to: dedicated-asia-1
      scale_up: 4
      reason: "auto-failover on high preemptions"
```
This avoids waiting until alert >0.9 which is what our current rule does.

Maya: Agreed — current threshold at 0.9 is too late. Can someone lower the alert to 0.4 and add an intermediate warning level that notifies SRE + ML infra channel? :white_check_mark:

Juan: I'll open PR to change alert thresholds and attach a short runbook with rollback steps and the dedicated fallback play. PR link in a sec.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-0832 (owner: Juan) — priority=P2

Kevin: Also add a synthetic probe that runs a small-batch inference every 2m against asia to detect SLO regressions earlier. It should trigger before heavy traffic hits.

Liam: I'll add the probe and update the dashboard panels (latency p95, preemptions per minute, machine_count) so oncall can correlate quickly.

Maya: Awesome. Action items: Juan PR thresholds + runbook, Liam dashboard + probe, Kevin routing rule PR. We'll reconvene after changes are live. Thanks everyone.
